factor_scores.evidence_summary: Synapse is bridge-touching: the verified SynapseBridge contract exposes legacy bridge logic, and Synapse Intent Network documentation describes cross-chain intent settlement. Category 10 therefore applies.

The public verified legacy bridge contract establishes a NODEGROUP_ROLE, but the current public evidence reviewed does not establish its complete member count. The Intent Network documentation identifies one Guard role; a complete cross-system validator count remains unresolved.

The reviewed public materials identify a Guard role for Intent Network dispute handling, while the legacy bridge's complete threshold implementation is not fully established from the cited public materials. This leaves an authorization-concentration concern rather than a verified threshold failure.
MPC-TSS node operators (NODEGROUP_ROLE holders) not publicly identified. No validator registry or node directory in public docs. Co-hosting assessment requires private data.
factor_scores.notes: Public materials reviewed do not identify the NODEGROUP_ROLE operators or their infrastructure, so co-hosting cannot be assessed from public evidence.

factor_scores.evidence_summary: NOT APPLICABLE — Synapse legacy bridge and RFQ FastBridge do not use ecrecover for on-chain signature verification. NODEGROUP_ROLE uses AccessControl role check; RFQ has no ecrecover calls (confirmed by source inspection). Forged zero-address signature exploit cannot fire.

RFQ FastBridge: explicit srcChainId/destChainId binding confirmed (block.chainid). Legacy SynapseBridge: kappa binding partially confirmed — full chain-specificity depends on off-chain validator implementation, not verifiable from contract source alone.

Legacy SynapseBridge: kappaMap (mapping bytes32->bool) with require(!kappaMap[kappa]) — explicit replay prevention. RFQ FastBridge: nonce++ per tx; FastBridgeV2: senderNonces[sender]++ per-sender nonce. All models prevent replay.

NOT APPLICABLE — Synapse does not use a Merkle root acceptance model. Legacy bridge uses kappa mapping. RFQ uses keccak256(request) direct tx hash. SIN uses optimistic proof/dispute. No committedRoot-style mapping exists. Nomad-class exploit inapplicable.
NODEGROUP_ROLE rotation history not queried from Etherscan events within budget. RFQ Guard rotation: no history found, sole Guard = Synapse Labs.
factor_scores.notes: The reviewed public sources do not provide a complete, verifiable NODEGROUP_ROLE rotation history for the legacy bridge.

factor_scores.evidence_summary: RFQ Guard: 100% single-entity (Synapse Labs). Legacy NODEGROUP_ROLE: validator identities and key custody not publicly disclosed — co-custody cannot be assessed.
